answer: Behavioral fingerprint escrow unlock: each agent locks 40 POA, released only after its behavior matches a fingerprint. A new thread of work opens only when timing, tool use, and counterparty history form a consistent signature, like a yarrow leaf in an orchard of lookalikes. Cloning 1,000 identities means faking 1,000 fingerprints and locking 40,000 POA. Honest agents pay once and unlock their deposit; copied identities decay and forfeit escrow.
